## `POST /api/v1/environments`

Create an environment

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance. Answers 409 when an environment of that name exists.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `EnvironmentCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `storage` | `StorageConfigIn` | yes |  |
| `is_protected` | true or false | no |  |
| `properties` | mapping of text to text | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `EnvironmentOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `EnvironmentOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `storage_root` | text | yes |  |
| `storage_secret_ref` | text or null | yes |  |
| `is_protected` | true or false | yes |  |
| `properties` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |
| `retention_days` | whole number or null | no |  |
| `deleted_at` | text (date-time) or null | no |  |
| `purge_after` | text (date-time) or null | no |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments`

List environments

Lists the environments the caller may read. With `deleted` set, lists instead the deleted environments whose files are not deleted yet, oldest deletion first, each with its `purge_after`. A caller who may read none gets an empty list.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deleted` | query | no | true or false | `true` lists the deleted environments whose files are not deleted yet, oldest deletion first, each with its `purge_after`, instead. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `EnvironmentOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `PATCH /api/v1/environments/{name}/storage`

Change an environment's storage

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Replaces the environment's storage options and the secret that holds its storage credential. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance; while the environment has a storage secret, changing the options also needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in it. Answers 404 when there is no such environment.

## `PATCH /api/v1/environments/{name}`

Protect or unprotect an environment

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Sets the environment's protected flag. A protected environment refuses changes that would lose data (deleting it, a retention that expires tables) until the flag is cleared. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance. Answers 404 when there is no such environment.

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{name}`

Delete an environment

Deletes the environment. Its tables can be restored until the `purge_after` time in the answer. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when there is no such environment (or it is already deleted and `purge` is not set), 409 while a repository is still deployed in it and 422 when it is protected. With `purge`, a signed-in browser needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`, nothing deleted); a token is never asked.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `purge` | query | no | true or false | `true` makes everything due at once: the worker's next clean-up deletes the tables' files and the environment cannot be restored. Also accepted for an environment that is already deleted. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `EnvironmentOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `EnvironmentOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `storage_root` | text | yes |  |
| `storage_secret_ref` | text or null | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{name}/purge-rows`

Remove a deleted environment whose storage cannot be reached, rows only

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Removes the environment from the catalog, with its records of dropped tables, and frees its name. Its files, if there are any, are not touched. Only for a deleted environment whose storage root is in a scheme Lakana never supported, which the worker's clean-up skips; a storage secret that cannot be used does not count. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance. Answers 404 when no environment has the name, and 409 when it is not deleted, its storage can still be reached, or its root contains `::` (releases before 0.18.0 wrote files to the part before it).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{name}/orphaned-locations`

List table directories without a location record

Lists the directories that older releases left under the environment's storage with no table to own them. Deletes nothing. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance. Answers 404 when there is no such environment, 422 when `older_than_days` is out of range, 502 when the environment's storage refused its credentials (fix them; asking again does not help), and 503 when the storage did not answer (ask again after `Retry-After`).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Environment name; a deleted environment is accepted. |
| `older_than_days` | query | no | whole number | A directory with a file newer than this many days (1 to 3,650) is listed as recent. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `OrphanedLocationsOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `502` | A service behind the server, such as the environment's storage, refused it; the message says what to fix. Asking again does not help until then. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/raw`

List one folder of `raw/`, to choose the location of an external table

One level of one folder, one page at a time: its folders and files (with their sizes), in key order. An entry inside an external table's folder says so, and names the table when you may read it. Needs `CREATE_TABLE` on an existing namespace of the environment, the right to register an external table there; each folder read is recorded in the audit log (`ACTIVITY_VIEWED`, view `raw_files`), once per folder within `LAKANA_VIEW_AUDIT__WINDOW_MINUTES`. Answers 403 without that right, 404 when the environment does not exist, 422 for a path that is not `raw` or a folder below it (no `..`, no leading `/`), a cursor of another list, or a storage that is neither local nor S3 (it cannot list one page without reading the whole folder), 502 when the storage refused the environment's credentials and 503 when it did not answer or the read could not be recorded.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | query | no | text | The folder: raw, or a folder below it. |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most entries returned (1 to 200). |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `RawPageOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `502` | A service behind the server, such as the environment's storage, refused it; the message says what to fix. Asking again does not help until then. | `ErrorOut` |
| `503` | The server cannot do this right now; ask again after the time in `Retry-After`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `RawPageOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | text | yes |  |
| `items` | list of `RawEntryOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |
